comment:
* A timeout that has triggered on the system.
 *
 * @hide

variables.name: mKind
variables.comment: Kind of timeout, e.g. BROADCAST_RECEIVER, etc.

variables.name: mEndUptimeMillis
variables.comment: System uptime in millis when the timeout was triggered.

variables.name: mEndTakenBeforeLocks
variables.comment:
* Was the end timestamp taken right after the timeout triggered, before any potentially
     * expensive operations such as taking locks?

variables.name: mLatencyTracker
variables.comment: Latency tracker associated with this instance.
